name: @vexa/dashboard
description: Vexa Dashboard — a simple, modern meetings + transcripts web client on the Vexa core. Runs alongside the Terminal on its own port; same auth contract, narrower surface.
_overrides_comment: Advisory floors for transitive deps of the SHIPPED dashboard image, which is built with `npm ci` from package-lock.json (see Dockerfile) and therefore does not see pnpm-workspace.yaml's overrides. Keep this list in sync with clients/terminal/package.json for any package present in both trees.
